# Vendor/product names, anchored to an attribution phrase so an unrelated
# mention of the product (e.g. a changelog note about a "Copilot" feature)
# doesn't trip this on its own. Signed-off-by/Authorized-by are included
# alongside Co-authored-by since some tools (and the DCO convention) use
# those trailers instead.
#
# Bare "claude" is deliberately excluded from this line only: "Claude" is a
# common human first name, and a trailer is exactly where a real co-author
# named Claude would appear. "claude code" (two words) is used instead;
# noreply@anthropic.com below covers the actual default trailer regardless.
(co-?authored-?by|signed-?off-?by|authorized-?by):.*(claude code|anthropic|opencode|openai|chatgpt|gpt-?[0-9]|codex|copilot|gemini|grok|mistral ai|deepseek|qwen|cursor|windsurf|codeium|aider|tabnine|amazon q|codewhisperer)
generated (with|by).*(claude|anthropic|opencode|openai|chatgpt|gpt-?[0-9]|codex|copilot|gemini|grok|mistral ai|deepseek|qwen|cursor|windsurf|codeium|aider|tabnine|amazon q|codewhisperer)
(written|authored|created|made) by (claude|anthropic|opencode|openai|chatgpt|gpt-?[0-9]|codex|copilot|gemini|grok|mistral ai|deepseek|qwen|cursor|windsurf|codeium|aider|tabnine|amazon q|codewhisperer)
powered by (claude|anthropic|openai|chatgpt|gpt-?[0-9]|copilot|gemini|grok|codex)
🤖 generated with

# Self-identification text, for raw model output pasted in without editing.
as an? (ai|large) language model

# Reference URLs unique to one vendor's own tooling; safe to match bare
# since nothing unrelated would ever cite these exact paths.
claude\.ai/code
claude\.com/claude-code

# Tool-name suffixes some CLIs append straight to the git author/committer
# name field instead of writing a message trailer. Aider's default (opt-out)
# behavior uses parens; a common Codex CLI wrapper pattern uses the same
# convention, and both parenthesized and bracketed forms show up in the wild.
\(aider\)
\[aider\]
\(codex\)

# Bot identities that are unambiguous on their own, so they don't need an
# attribution-phrase anchor. Deliberately NOT matching bare "devin" or
# "jules" or "cody" in the phrase patterns above: those are common human
# first names and would false-positive on a real co-author.
devin-ai-integration\[bot\]
google-labs-jules\[bot\]
gemini-code-assist\[bot\]
github-copilot\[bot\]
noreply@anthropic\.com
noreply@openai\.com
cursoragent@cursor\.com
[0-9]+\+copilot@users\.noreply\.github\.com
